oneLiner: The aquarium keeper's math toolkit: tank volume for any shape, substrate, heater, filter, water changes, CO2, salinity and fertilizer dosing, each verified against published references.
audience: Freshwater hobbyists setting up or upgrading a tank, including planted-tank keepers
Reef and saltwater keepers (salinity, specific gravity, top-off, water changes)
US gallons and inches first, with litres and centimetres everywhere
mustHave: Fish-welfare and safety notes where they matter
competitors: Search for these by name: tankmatcher, aquapacity, app-aquatic, aquariumstocking. Typical gaps are volume-only tools, unexplained formulas, no salinity temperature correction, and thin pages. Beat them on breadth, verified chemistry and explanations.
monetization: The owner may add ads or affiliate links later. Never add them yourself.
doneText:
# DONE

Site: https://mathtank.netlify.app (TankMath, an aquarium maths toolkit). v1 (11 pages), v2 (8), v3 (5), v4 (6) and v5 (7 new pages) are built; v5 took 7 runs in one session. Earlier reports: `.ai/done-v1.md` to `.ai/done-v4.md`.

## What was built
All 37 pages, each in the sitemap. Every calculating page has a pure lib in `site/js/lib/`, unit tests in `tests/unit/`, a browser spec, a sitemap line, cross-links, and (new in v5) a link in the home page's "All aquarium calculators" list.

**v5 (this round)**

| Page | Target keyword cluster | Lib + unit test |
|---|---|---|
| `/tds-to-ppm-converter/` | TDS to ppm, EC to ppm, 500 vs 700 scale, TDS meter conversion | `lib/tds.js` |
| `/aquarium-electricity-cost-calculator/` | aquarium electricity cost, how much does a fish tank cost to run, heater running cost | `lib/electricity.js` |
| `/ro-di-waste-water-ratio-calculator/` | RO waste water ratio, RO/DI recovery, membrane rejection rate | `lib/rodi.js` |
| `/dosing-pump-calibration-calculator/` | dosing pump calibration, mL per dose, doser run time | `lib/dosingpump.js` |
| `/aquarium-salt-dose-calculator/` | aquarium salt per gallon, freshwater aquarium salt calculator, salt bath | `lib/freshsalt.js`, `data/freshsalt.json` |
| `/conductivity-to-salinity/` | conductivity to salinity, mS/cm to ppt, salinity probe | `lib/conductivity.js` (PSS-78) |
| `/hexagon-pentagon-aquarium-volume/` | hexagon aquarium volume, flat-back hexagon gallons, pentagon tank volume | `lib/hexagon.js` |

Also: the home page now ends with a grouped list of every tool (`#all-tools`).

**Earlier rounds:** `/` (tank volume), `/aquarium-sizes/`, `/substrate-calculator/`, `/heater-size-calculator/`, `/filter-flow-calculator/`, `/water-change-calculator/`, `/co2-calculator/`, `/salinity-calculator/`, `/salt-mix-calculator/`, `/fertilizer-calculator/`, `/tank-weight-calculator/` (v1); `/bow-front-aquarium-volume/`, `/cylinder-aquarium-volume/`, `/corner-aquarium-volume/`, `/specific-gravity-to-ppt/`, `/refractometer-calibration/`, `/nitrate-water-change-schedule/`, `/aquarium-evaporation-top-off-calculator/`, `/ei-dosing-calculator/` (v2); `/kh-to-ppm-converter/`, `/fishless-cycle-ammonia-calculator/`, `/sump-volume-calculator/`, `/reef-alkalinity-calcium-dosing-calculator/`, `/dgh-gh-water-hardness-converter/` (v3); `/ro-water-remineralization-calculator/`, `/ammonia-toxicity-calculator/`, `/aquarium-chiller-size-calculator/`, `/drip-acclimation-calculator/`, `/magnesium-dosing-calculator/`, `/kalkwasser-dosing-calculator/` (v4).

## Test results
`npm test` passes on the last commit: `check` OK (37 pages), 197 unit tests, 236 browser tests (laptop 1366×633 and Pixel 7). A reviewer subagent checked every unit before its push. Blockers it found and fixed: a backwards claim about RO flow restrictors, an electricity price cap that rejected most non-dollar currencies, and a flat-back hexagon model that missed the square end panels (under-read real tanks by about 8%). Minors fixed: unit-switch traps (salt concentration now converts instead of reinterpreting; RO production label shows its unit), clearer out-of-range and unit-mix-up messages, and a dosing example that asked for an unreadably small measurement.

## Unsure or left out (honest list)
- **Skipped as duplicate:** `/hydrometer-temperature-correction/`; the salinity calculator already corrects hydrometer readings for temperature.
- **Skipped as unverifiable:** protein skimmer sizing (makers publish only per-model bioload claims) and a PAR lighting guide (sources disagree).
- **PSS-78 coefficients:** taken from UNESCO 1983 and verified by matching the TEOS-10 GSW Python package to 0.0002 across the range. That package was used only as a dev-time check in a scratchpad, never shipped. Search results confirmed only some of the coefficients directly.
- **Freshwater salt page:** the reference levels are aquaculture figures (UF/IFAS VM007) plus the API label rate. The page says species differ and that sick fish need a diagnosis; it shows a warning above 3 ppt and a dip warning at 10 ppt and above.
- **Electricity page:** the heater's on-time is entered by the visitor, not estimated, because the heater sizing rule includes margin.
- **RO page:** temperature and pressure effects on production are described but not calculated, because published correction factors disagree.
- **Site-wide:** `num()` reads "1,500" as 1.5 (comma as a decimal point). Left alone for visitors who type decimal commas.
- The `google-site-verification` tag is on the home page and untouched.

## Owner launch checklist
1. Check that the Netlify site serves https://mathtank.netlify.app.
2. Add that address to Search Console as a URL-prefix property (the verification meta tag is on `/`) and submit `/sitemap.xml`.
3. Buy tankmath.app once there is budget, then move over with 301 redirects (only the owner changes the address).

## 10 best next pages (ranked by likely search demand and how weak the current results are)
1. `/pond-volume-calculator/`: rectangular, round and irregular ponds in gallons and litres (IDEA "nice to have"; geometry, verifiable).
2. `/nitrate-nitrogen-converter/`: NO3 vs NO3-N, PO4 vs PO4-P, total ammonia as N (molar masses; test kits and lab reports disagree on units).
3. `/aquarium-glass-thickness-calculator/`: only once a published plate formula and safety factor are verified; strong safety note.
4. `/co2-cylinder-duration-calculator/`: how long a CO2 cylinder lasts from its fill weight and daily use (needs a sourced bubble volume or measured use).
5. `/return-pump-head-loss-calculator/`: sump return flow after head height and pipe friction (Hazen-Williams; maker flow curves).
6. `/pond-pump-size-calculator/`: turnover for ponds, once a sourced guideline exists.
7. `/overflow-drain-size-calculator/`: flow per drain pipe size, once a consistent source exists.
8. `/aquarium-stocking-guide/`: deliberately left out until species data are researched carefully (IDEA).
9. `/aquarium-lighting-par-guide/`: once one consistent PAR source exists.
10. `/protein-skimmer-size-guide/`: once a maker publishes a sizing basis.
